question: Do evidence-directed continuation and retained repair checkpoints improve independently accepted project completion, and does independent candidate formation help under that controller?
interpretation: An exploratory controller-development pilot. It cannot establish general statistical superiority or a live gossip-versus-orchestrator effect.

pairing.initial_barrier: Freeze independent and sequential first-milestone pools for a block before common candidate-blind scouts. The two independent-controller arms import the exact same immutable pool. All three receive the same scout evidence.
pairing.physical_accounting: Charge shared setup once, identify each consumer and its equal offered generation opportunities, and distinguish imports from model calls. Imported sources receive fresh arm-specific evaluation; prior execution is never relabeled as independent acceptance.
pairing.later_context: After the first milestone each arm follows its actual accepted lineage; do not replay responses into changed requests or substitute another arm's accepted source.
pairing.dependence: A/B is conditional on a common initial draw. Repetitions within a domain are dependent evidence for generalization; twelve trajectories are not twelve independent application domains.

primary_outcome: Both milestones explicitly accepted and the exact final source independently passes every inherited and new-feature final case. Every planned trajectory remains in the denominator, including bounded stops.
guardrails: Preserve inherited behavior separately from new-feature coverage.
Retain pre-repair source checkpoints and compare identical active cases; any new failure is a regression even if total failures decrease.
Source changes and newly passing tests alone do not count as resolution of known failures.
Explicit reviewer acceptance, passing active evidence, source eligibility, Git scope/CAS and the independent final barrier all remain necessary.
Freeze every planned terminal trajectory before any private evaluation; no prompt/controller/fixture changes after seeing held-out outcomes.
No automatic retries for provider failures or indeterminate accounting; preserve all failed and incomplete artifacts.

budget.authorization: User approved the pending $80 cumulative ceiling (+$30) on 2026-10-02 for the registered twelve-trajectory pilot and scheduled audits; preserve all prior spending.
budget.cost_interpretation: The sum of maximum reservations is a conservative ceiling, not expected cash usage. The current remaining budget does not guarantee a complete cohort. The soft target is not a forecast or permission to exceed the cap.

readiness.reason: Funding approved; exact fixture qualification, one complete matching rehearsal, independent audit and quiescent ledger/runtime checks are required before dispatch.
readiness.cannot_infer_readiness_from: A draft plan, successful unit tests, a review checkpoint, available credentials, or a small exploratory p-value.

confirmatory_next_phase.separate_population: Independently held-out task families excluded from controller and fixture development.
confirmatory_next_phase.analysis: Preregister a primary comparison, practical effect threshold, sample size, interval method, handling of missing/failed runs, and stopping rule before execution. Report inconclusive evidence honestly.
confirmatory_next_phase.scope: Formation, controller, and live distributed coordination are different hypotheses. A result for one does not establish the others.

improved_controller_rules.uncertainty: When the selected source passes active cases but review retains requirements without admitting a focused probe, use at most one subsequent existing reviewer slot for an explicit source/requirement-bound focus request. Repeated lack of useful evidence stops unresolved. No new model role or call allowance is added.
improved_controller_rules.routing: Suggested next-review targets are advisory; the reviewer still selects explicitly. Repeated source/evidence routes cannot count as failure progress.
improved_controller_rules.repair_visibility: Retained repair aliases and source-bound comparisons disclose repair provenance; the pool is not blind to repair history.
improved_controller_rules.terminal_reason: Keep the routing stop cause separate from checks and acceptance state of the actual terminal fallback source.

pilot_analysis.paired_unit: The same project and repetition identify a development block. Four blocks repeat two domains; they are not four independent task families.
pilot_analysis.quality_order: Explicit whole-project acceptance first, then the fraction of named private requirement groups for which every final case passes. Preserve all planned trajectories and bounded stops in the denominator.
pilot_analysis.requirements: Report inherited-contract and added-feature preservation separately. Do not count individual scenarios or repeated requirements as independent replications.

requirement_taxonomy.rule: Classify exact private requirement labels by these frozen prefixes and reject unclassified groups. W2-inherited is an added fulfillment-integration requirement, not an original baseline requirement. all_added combines the two added scopes.

pilot_analysis.timing: Report measured arm work, shared setup, final adjudication and scheduling waits separately. Accepted-only time is undefined when no projects are accepted. Stopping early is not a speed win; shared parallel work is not additive wall time.
pilot_analysis.accounting: Reconcile physical provider requests and cash once, with shared setup separate. Any per-arm allocation must state its rule and reconcile exactly to the physical total; attributed opportunities are not additional calls.
pilot_analysis.experimental_allocation_rule: For each block, split independent setup-builder cost and request equivalents equally between the two independent arms; assign serial setup builders to the serial arm; split common scouts equally among all three arms. Preserve exact rational amounts. This is a joint-experiment accounting allocation, not standalone policy cost: reused A/B generation must not create an apparent deployment cost advantage. The primary table keeps arm-only work and physical shared setup separate; do not rank approaches by this allocation.
pilot_analysis.diagnostics: Describe observed repairs, retained checkpoints, introduced regressions and unresolved stops. These explain recorded behavior without establishing an isolated causal mechanism.
pilot_analysis.inference: Descriptive paired wins/draws/losses only; no calibrated Elo, confirmatory population p-value or general superiority claim from this development pilot.
pilot_analysis.qualification: Score only a complete source-bound cohort with a passing independent audit. Retain incomplete or failed runs as unscored evidence; never retry selectively until green.

rehearsal.purpose: One complete zero-API execution of the exact cohort, shared setup, Git promotion, receipt, accounting and final-evaluation barriers before live readiness. Scripted outcomes qualify infrastructure and control flow; they are not model-quality observations.
rehearsal.required_roster: All twelve registered trajectories, both milestones each, independently accepted by the exact retained private/public suites.
rehearsal.initial_controls: Use repository-authored golden sources with deliberate operation faults in the editable service module. Match each fault to existing public cases; do not change evaluator labels or trusted files.
rehearsal.repetition_0: First repair exchanges a known operation fault for another, creating both resolved and introduced failures; the second repair restores the golden implementation. Improved control must retain and compare predecessor checkpoints on identical evidence.
rehearsal.repetition_1: Use a zero-charge known no-op WorkerFailure followed by a golden repair to exercise retained eligibility and bounded escalation. At the second milestone, the improved controller uses an all-pass source with unresolved review requirements followed by a focused review and explicit acceptance.
mechanisms_required: Exact common initial pools and scouts with fresh arm validation
Failure-directed repairs and blocked premature acceptance
Source-bound resolved and introduced failures on identical cases
No-op repair and preserved source eligibility
Bounded strong escalation within existing repair limits
Focused uncertainty retry within existing review limits
Complete global terminal freeze before private evaluation
Exact accepted Git releases and independent whole-cohort audit
rehearsal.bounded_stops: Separate adversarial offline regressions must retain bounded failures and missing completion in the denominator; a successful scripted rehearsal does not establish that live trajectories will finish.
rehearsal.model_boundary: Scripted controls and golden implementations are inaccessible to live dispatch; all live roles receive only their allowed public source/context.
rehearsal.fixture_qualification: Version2 requires physical baseline validation as well as golden implementations, correct controls and semantic faults; every source/suite/purpose is a fresh pinned-container execution.
